project.name: nablatensor-backend-opencl
project.description: OpenCL compute runtime via java.lang.foreign: the ICD loader is dlopened at runtime, kernels are built from source with clBuildProgram, and dispatch is a 1-D clEnqueueNDRangeKernel. No JNI and no native jar; compiles with or without an OpenCL runtime present and reports itself unavailable when the loader or a device is missing.
